entries.title: Queue
entries.text: Sent plans only. Asks the orchestrator to move the build on now: split it if it is not split yet, and start it when it is next in line. The answer says where it stands.

entries.title: Hold
entries.text: Sent plans only. A build still waiting its turn keeps its place and is skipped until you release it. A build that is already being built cannot be held: cancel it instead.

entries.title: Release
entries.text: Takes a held build off hold. It takes its turn again, at once when nothing else is being built.

entries.title: Retry
entries.text: Sent plans only. A failed build and its failed steps start again from where they failed. The attempt counts start over.

entries.title: Rebuild
entries.text: On a failed step: builds that step again. On a plan whose build failed while landing: pulls main into its pull request again and recompiles it. Refused when nothing has failed.

entries.title: Run CI
entries.text: Sends a build that failed at CI back to Running CI, or has CI checked now when it is already there. Refused before the steps are merged into one pull request.

entries.title: Land
entries.text: Asks the lander to take a built build now instead of waiting for its next round. A build that failed while landing is retried first. Refused while steps are still being built.

entries.title: Cancel the build
entries.text: Takes the build out of the orchestrator (archived). The plan unlocks and the planning steps you sent come back. A session still running ends on its own and nothing of it lands.

entries.title: Open in orchestrator
entries.text: Opens this plan's build in the Build orchestrator.

entries.title: Replaced planning steps
entries.text: Shows the planning steps that left this item when the orchestrator filed its own steps. You can bring them back once the plan is no longer locked.

entries.title: Open in orchestrator
entries.text: Opens this plan's build in the Build orchestrator.

entries.title: Bring these steps back
entries.text: Puts these planning steps back into the item where they were. Refused while the plan is locked by a sent build.

entries.title: Mark steps from the orchestrator with
entries.text: How steps the orchestrator filed are told apart from your own: a From orchestrator badge, a tinted row, or both.

entries.title: Live progress of sent plans
entries.text: How often the page reads the builds store again while a sent plan is still moving, so steps check off in place. Off means you reload by hand.

entries.title: Done mark
entries.text: What shows a step in this state as done or not: a check box, a check mark, or nothing.

entries.title: Text colour
entries.text: The colour of a step's title in this state, taken from the theme.

entries.title: Background
entries.text: A soft tint behind a row in this state, taken from the theme.

entries.title: Font
entries.text: The font of a step's title in this state: the normal, the monospace or the display font of the theme.

entries.title: Weight
entries.text: How heavy a step's title is in this state.

entries.title: Style
entries.text: Normal or italic for a step's title in this state.

entries.title: State badge
entries.text: Shows the state as a badge on the row. The badge carries the orchestrator's status, so status styles and badge packs apply to it.

entries.title: Strike-through
entries.text: Crosses out the title of a step in this state.

entries.title: Reset every state
entries.text: Puts the look of every state back to the defaults.

entries.title: Reset the panes
entries.text: Puts the IDE panes back to the picked pane layout (a dock-layout asset): every section returns, splits and sizes start over. Also plan-studio-2.dock:reset.

entries.title: Close this pane
entries.text: Closes the pane; its sections go to Reopen on the toolbar. The last pane never closes. Also plan-studio-2.dock:close-pane:<pane>.

entries.title: New plan
entries.text: Starts a plan at the top level. Everything else goes inside something.

entries.title: Undo delete
entries.text: Brings the last deleted item (and everything under it) back where it was.

entries.title: Expand all
entries.text: Opens every branch of the tree.

entries.title: Collapse all
entries.text: Folds every branch to its top row.

entries.title: Export all as Markdown
entries.text: Downloads the whole tree as one Markdown file.

entries.title: Reload
entries.text: Reads the tree again from the store.

entries.title: Tree
entries.text: Every plan, section, step, note and list, nested.

entries.title: Trash
entries.text: Deleted items waiting to be restored.

entries.title: Find
entries.text: Type words: matching rows are listed with their path.

entries.title: Show done
entries.text: Off hides steps and list items already ticked.

entries.title: Say it
entries.text: A plain sentence: new plan X, add a step Y to X, rename X to Y, move X into Y, delete X, undo.

entries.title: Run
entries.text: Runs the sentence in the box.

entries.title: Talk
entries.text: Listens and does what you say, turn after turn, until you say stop.

entries.title: Stop
entries.text: Stops listening.

entries.title: New inside
entries.text: Adds something inside this item.

entries.title: Move to…
entries.text: Picks where this item (and everything under it) goes.

entries.title: Link…
entries.text: Links this item to a to-do, a build, a note, a Shipped feature, another item or a web address. Nothing is synced.

entries.title: Send to build…
entries.text: Sends this item to the Build orchestrator as one pending build; its open steps go along as planning notes and Fable designs the build steps.

entries.title: Delete
entries.text: Moves it to the trash; Undo brings it back.

entries.title: Title
entries.text: What the item is called.

entries.title: Notes
entries.text: Anything about it, as long as you like.

entries.title: Kind
entries.text: Plan, section, step, note, list or list item. Any kind can hold any other.

entries.title: Status
entries.text: Idea, draft, active, parked or done.

entries.title: Priority
entries.text: P0 first, P3 last.

entries.title: Model
entries.text: Which model should build this step.

entries.title: Minutes
entries.text: How long the step should take.

entries.title: Tags
entries.text: Words to find it by, separated by commas.

entries.title: Save
entries.text: Keeps the changes.

entries.title: Discard
entries.text: Drops the changes since the last save.

entries.title: Restore
entries.text: Brings this deleted item back where it was.

entries.title: Add
entries.text: Adds the item.

entries.title: Cancel
entries.text: Closes without changing anything.

entries.title: Move
entries.text: Moves it there.

entries.title: Into
entries.text: Which item it goes inside; Top level puts it beside the plans.

entries.title: Link to
entries.text: What kind of thing the link points at.

entries.title: Reference
entries.text: The id, path or address of what you link to.

entries.title: Label
entries.text: Words shown instead of the reference.

entries.title: Add link
entries.text: Adds the link to the item.

entries.title: Build id
entries.text: The build's id in the orchestrator; made from the title when empty.

entries.title: Send to the orchestrator
entries.text: Files the build. Only then does it become a build.

entries.title: Plan Studio 2.0
entries.text: Its settings: what is shown, the model for new steps, the voice.

entries.title: Show done steps and list items
entries.text: Off hides what is already ticked.

entries.title: Model for new steps
entries.text: Filled in on every new step unless you pick another.

entries.title: Spoken replies
entries.text: Who answers out loud: Agent voice when installed, else the device.

entries.title: Voice language
entries.text: The language the microphone listens for.

entries.title: New plan (Plan Studio 2.0)
entries.text: Starts a plan in Plan Studio 2.0.

entries.title: New inside
entries.text: Adds something inside this item.

entries.title: Rename / edit
entries.text: Opens the item to rename or edit it.

entries.title: Done / not done
entries.text: Ticks or unticks the step.

entries.title: Duplicate
entries.text: A copy of it and everything under it, right after it.

entries.title: Move up
entries.text: One place up among its neighbours.

entries.title: Move down
entries.text: One place down among its neighbours.

entries.title: Indent
entries.text: Into the item above it.

entries.title: Outdent
entries.text: Out to after its parent.

entries.title: Move to
entries.text: Picks where it goes.

entries.title: Link to
entries.text: Links it to a to-do, build, note, Shipped feature, item or address.

entries.title: Export as Markdown
entries.text: Downloads this item and everything under it.

entries.title: Send to build orchestrator
entries.text: It becomes one pending build; Fable designs its build steps.

entries.title: Delete
entries.text: To the trash; Undo on the toolbar brings it back.

entries.title: Undo the last delete
entries.text: Brings the last deleted item back.

entries.title: Plan Studio 2.0
entries.text: A clean planning tree (plan-tree@1): plans, sections, steps, notes and lists nested inside each other to any depth, dragged to move or reorder at any level, every item with a full context menu (new inside, rename, edit, duplicate, move, delete with undo, export, send to the build orchestrator).

entries.title: Plan Studio 2.0
entries.text: Opens Plan Studio 2.0, the planning tree.

entries.title: Shipped
entries.text: The shipped manifest this plan received when the build it was sent as shipped: Brett's words first, then what landed (commit, PR, branch, when), the totals and the details (steps estimate vs actual, files, tests, still open, the brief). It is checked against shipped-manifest@1 before it is kept. Only plans sent from Plan Studio receive one.

entries.title: Shipped manifest refused
entries.text: A shipped manifest for this plan's build was not valid, so it was refused: every field that was wrong is listed. Nothing of it was kept; a valid manifest the plan had before stays. The next valid manifest for the build clears this. Check all of them with check-shipped (tree.mjs check-shipped, or GET /api/plugins/plan-studio-2/check-shipped).

steps.say: One tree. Plans hold sections, sections hold steps, steps hold lists, and anything can hold anything, as deep as you like.
Start with New plan, then add inside it with the plus on a row.
Right-click or long-press any row for everything you can do to it; drag the grip to move it anywhere.
Or just say it: type or speak a sentence like “add a step Deploy to Launch”.
